lines.en: I flutter past on slow wings.
One beat and the air shifts.
I settle and lift from grass tips.
I follow the smell of flowers.
I loop once, then go on.
I flashed in the sunlight.
The flowerbeds are my signposts.
The wind pushed me off course.
I rest on a leaf.
The pattern on my wings stands out.

lines.zh: 我从一棵花飞到另一棵。
lines.en: From one flower to the next.
Half a turn around the bush.
I ride the air upward.
I'm resting on a flower.
My wings open and close slowly.
Sunning myself warm.
There's a hint of sweetness on the petal.
I twitch my antennae now and then.
The dew hasn't dried off yet.
I hid under the leaf a while.
This patch is nearly done blooming.
My life isn't very long.
I lift my wingtips.
You're blocking my flowers.
Don't wave. The wind will take me.
You don't smell of flowers.
I'm this small, and you see me?

lines.zh: 你的影子让我找不到花。
lines.en: Your shadow hides the flowers.
Let me fly past, please.
I'll rest on your shoulder a moment.
You don't look like a flower watcher.
I'm light. I won't touch you.
I dropped a bit of height.

lines.zh: 我翅膀被拍歪，鳞粉撒了一路。
lines.en: My wing is knocked askew, and scales trail behind me.
I came down on the grass.
A small piece of my wing is gone.
My antennae feel numb.
I'll fly low from here.
My scales are scattered on the ground.
Careful. My wings tear.
Nectar. Only nectar.
Is this flower for me?

lines.zh: 花蜜的味道，我绕着不走。
lines.en: I keep circling that smell of nectar.
Don't tease me with a leaf.
Too far. I can't reach it.
This flower's already wilting.
Let me land and try.
A little is enough. I eat little.
Keep your hand still. I'm coming.
The brighter the flower, the sweeter.
Scale dust is stuck to your sleeve.
Scale dust is on your hand now.
I've moved aside.
Your body broke the airflow.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的袖子过去了。
lines.en: I slipped past your sleeve.
Careful. My wings are thin.
I lost a little height.
Don't swat at me with your hand.
I've gone around your other side.
My whole life is a single season.
There are plenty of my kind at the flowers.
I need to find enough nectar first.
Such things are brief and urgent.
I won't discuss that with you.
While my wings can still beat.
I beat my wings and left.

lines.zh: 翅膀上的花纹才是关键。
lines.en: The pattern on my wings is what matters.
Wrong species.
The wind carried me off.
I hold it with my legs.
Too heavy. I can't fly with it.
A bit of pollen stuck to me.
Not a flower. I won't touch it.
I drag it onto a petal.
This thing is too slippery.
I tried. Too hard.
That isn't something to eat.
This isn't something to eat.
I lost track of it.
Something's moving over there.
I saw a shadow.
A bird, or a person?

lines.zh: 草叶晃了，我先飞上树梢。
lines.en: The grass twitched, so I climb to the treetops first.
Behind this flower isn't safe.
That flower is nodding in the wind.
The wind carries it this way.
I've raised my wings.
It's very near the flowerbed.
I need to go around here.
That thing still hasn't left.
I'm hiding under the petals.
I'm trying not to beat my wings.
The wind keeps pushing me off.
It raised one hand.
I circle half around the blossom.
I'll leave by the other side.
My shadow is on it.
It's not looking this way.
I flapped at it once.
Scale dust went in your eyes.
Your hand's wave blew me off.
I landed on your cuff.
I brushed your finger.
I flew off quickly.
That was only an accident.
Even my wingbeat cuts.
The flowerbed is right here.
The sun lights up my pattern.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己能飞多远。
lines.en: I don't know how far I can fly.
This place smells sweet.
I settle on a petal.
The wind lifted me up.
I can see flowers far off.
Out of the flowers I come.

lines.zh: 热浪把我的翅膀烤卷了。
lines.en: The heat curled my wings.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，落在泥里。
lines.en: I dropped into the mud.
Water glued me to the leaf.

lines.zh: 冲击把花和我一起掀翻。
lines.en: The blast flipped flower and me together.

lines.zh: 那光让我的鳞粉全掉了。
lines.en: That light shook all my scales loose.

lines.zh: 雷光照得我分不清方向。
lines.en: The flash left me blind to direction.

lines.zh: 我往下跌，翅膀不听使唤。
lines.en: Falling, and my wings won't answer.
